dedupe_keys.name: korea public transport ridership from transit card big data molit stcis

description: The Korean Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport publishes public transport ridership derived from nationwide transit card records through the public data portal. A summary file gives trip volumes by region, user type, stop and route, split into single and transfer trips, with trends by time of day; a REST API returns daily passenger volumes per route, aggregated by day, month and year, to support analysis of congestion, headways, route optimisation and demand-based service planning. The data come from the Transit Card Big Data Integrated Information System (STCIS) and are maintained by the ministry's public transport welfare division under the Act on the Support and Promotion of Mass Transit. Coverage is national. The summary is an XLSX file, first registered in September 2023 and updated automatically (last June 2025); the route API, registered in February 2025 and revised in April 2026, serves JSON and XML. Both are free with no restriction on use; the API needs a portal account and an automatically approved key with 1,000 calls a day for development. Caveats: the figures are aggregates, not individual trips, the documentation is in Korean, the spatial and temporal extents are not stated on the portal, and the STCIS site itself could not be reached from this environment. The data support network flow and capacity planning of bus and metro services and complement city ridership data such as the Istanbul and Argentine smart card records catalogued here.
